candidates.title: Truckee/Lake Tahoe Unmet Transit Needs Public Workshop (jointly hosted)
warnings: The official Town of Truckee event listing states that TRPA, PCTPA, Nevada County Transportation Commission, and TNT/TMA invited public comment on unmet transit needs in the Truckee/Lake Tahoe region. It lists October 1, 2026, 10:00–11:00 AM at 221 Fairway Drive, Tahoe City, and a Zoom option. No separate agenda or completion record was linked; status remains unknown.
